content.text:
Todos now sort by priority: high, then med, then low. Todos with the same priority keep the order they were added. Completed todos still sit below active ones (DEC-003), and the priority sort applies within each of those two groups.
I kept that rule because this request didn't cancel it. The alternative was one priority sort across all todos, which would put a completed high todo above an active low one.
The saved list is unchanged, and todos with no valid priority count as med (DEC-004, DEC-007).
